$comment: Interface dictionary for the default locale. Keys are flat and dotted; every key here must also exist in every other locale dictionary (src/i18n.mjs enforces parity and rejects empty strings). The "site." namespace is the exception: the default locale reads those strings from config/site.config.json, so they are absent here on purpose. Placeholders are {braced} and are substituted by the templates.
footer.rights_note: Where a record cites sources, its cooking facts are summarized here in our own words. No source text or image is reproduced, and rights in third-party material stay with their owners.
meta.about: How this {siteName} build is configured and what its content status is.
hall.further_desc: The hall is built to hold more shelves than the two standing here. None are seeded yet, and none are implied.
hall.what_body: {siteName} is an independent, statically built Library framework: a hall, a collection gallery with search and a region filter, and one generated page per record. There is no backend and no runtime server requirement for browsing the deployed output.
hall.shared_note: It is kept as a shared library rather than a publication: two people add to it slowly, and each record stays labelled with what it is and where it came from, so it is still legible to anyone else who opens it.
gallery.empty_body: This collection holds only {total} records, so most searches will come up empty. That is the collection being small, not the search being broken.
gallery.empty_hint: Try clearing the region filter, searching a shorter word, or {reset}.
gallery.noscript: Search, filtering, and the collection lenses need JavaScript. Without it the catalogue below simply lists every record in the collection, each one still reachable as its own page, and every link on this site works with scripting disabled.
translation.missing_notice: This record has no translation for this language yet, so its text is shown in the original English.
translation.partial_notice: This record is only partly translated. Untranslated fields are shown in the original English.
detail.variants_note: Variants are held side by side. The record does not nominate one of them as the definitive version.
facts.region_basis_note: a presentation facet, not an attribution claim
facts.translation_partial: partly translated; untranslated fields fall back to English
facts.translation_none: not translated; the English original is shown
story.facts.class_note: an original work of fiction, written for this Library
story.facts.author: Author
story.facts.origin_note: no source is recorded, and none is owed: the work summarizes nothing and quotes nothing
record_nav.label: Other records in this collection
about.name_body: The official name of this project is {siteName}. It is a distinct project from Atom-KB's separate Library: the two hold different content in different stores, and this build neither mirrors, syncs, nor supersedes Atom-KB's. A link between them, if one is ever configured, is a pointer and not a source-of-truth relationship.
about.status_body: This deployment contains {count} records in {collection}: {sourced} sourced, {practical} original practical notes, and {fixture} fixture.
about.stories_body: Beside it stands {shelf}, a separate shelf of original fiction holding {works}. A story is not a knowledge record: it makes no factual claim, so it is neither sourced, reviewed, nor testable, and it is published as its author's own text rather than as knowledge.
about.sourced.cites: It names the page its quantities, oven temperature and timings come from, with the date that page was read, and it cites the food-safety authority behind any temperature threshold it states.
about.sourced.paraphrase: Its directions are written here in this project's own words. No source text or photograph is reproduced, and rights in the cited page stay with its author and publisher.
about.sourced.untested: It has been checked against its source, but it has not been cooked or tested here and it has had no professional food-safety review. Where a source gave only a vague endpoint, an attributed temperature threshold is given beside it.
about.practical_title: What an original practical note is
about.practical.authored: It is everyday cooking written here for this repository — not summarized from anyone else's page, and not a demonstration record either. Where it gives a temperature to cook to, it hands the reader back to the food-safety authority published where they live, because the record names none of its own.
about.practical.nosources: It carries no sources, and that is the honest state rather than a gap: it makes no claim about any published recipe, so there is nothing to cite. A note that ever acquires real sources is promoted to a sourced record instead of being annotated after the fact.
about.practical.untested: It has not been cooked in a test kitchen here, it has had no professional food-safety review, and it is not publication-ready. Its times and temperatures are starting points for your own appliance, not verified results.
about.notfixture_title: What a fixture record is not
about.notfixture.sources: It is not researched, and it carries no source URLs. The source list is empty rather than filled with a placeholder.
about.notfixture.claims: It makes no claim about the history, origin, authenticity, or regional ownership of any dish.
about.notfixture.tested: It has not been cooked or tested, and no outcome is reported.
about.notfixture.images: It contains no images, and its image-rights review state says so explicitly.
about.notfixture.labels: Region and cuisine labels on fixture records exist to exercise the filter interface. Their {basis} field records that they are illustrative.
about.notfixture.translation: Its translations are the same fixture text in another language. Translating a fixture does not research it, source it, test it, or review it.
about.languages_body: This build is generated once per interface language. English is the documented default and is served from the site root; every other language is served from its own route prefix, so a deep link carries its language with it and the page declares that language in its {langAttr} attribute.
about.languages_persistence: The switch in the header stores the chosen language in {storage} under the key {key}. Storage can be unavailable — private browsing, a sandboxed document, a user setting — and in that case the switch still works for the current visit and simply does not persist. Nothing else is stored, and no account, cookie, or server is involved.
about.languages_fallback: Interface text is translated in full for every supported language. Record text is translated per record: a record with no translation for the selected language is shown in its original English behind a visible notice, rather than as blank fields or raw keys.
about.citadel_unset: not configured — the header slot renders inert
about.backend_value: none; the deployed site is static files only
about.external_value: none; no fonts, images, analytics, or third-party scripts are fetched
about.config_note: The base path and the Citadel link are set in {file}, and either can be overridden by environment variable at build time. No repository name or host is compiled into the source.
